name: Fletcher Kittredge
oneLineBio: Founder of GWI, Maine's B Corp internet provider.
bio: Fletcher founded and led GWI (Great Works Internet) in Biddeford for three decades, building it into Maine's first B Corp-certified telecom carrier. He also chairs the ConnectME Authority Advisory Board and serves on the board of the Maine Center for Public Interest Reporting.

name: Joshua Tan
oneLineBio: Leads tech at Current AI and product and strategy for Public AI.
bio: Josh leads product and strategy for the movement for public AI, building AI as public infrastructure. He is also CTO at Current AI, a global nonprofit building public options for AI.

name: Matthew Victor
oneLineBio: Technologist and lawyer at Harvard and Partners in Democracy.
bio: Matt leads digital infrastructure initiatives at Partners in Democracy, where he is responsible for developing the Massachusetts Platform for Legislative Engagement (MAPLE) and related civic technology systems that strengthen participatory lawmaking and public deliberation. He was previously an associate at Bernstein Shur.

name: Ben Polsky
oneLineBio: Data center and broadband infrastructure strategist at Vivacity and Stanford.
bio: Ben is Director of Partnership and Business Development at Vivacity Infrastructure Group, focused on data center and utility partnerships. He previously managed California's $3.87 billion open-access middle-mile broadband program and is a Fellow at Stanford's McCoy Center for Ethics in Society.

name: Tom Law
oneLineBio: Founder and CEO of Oak AI, a Maine-based applied-AI startup.
bio: Tom founded Oak AI in Portland to build AI tools that give people more agency and privacy online. He previously spent over a decade in engineering leadership roles across wireless, energy, and robotics.

name: Richard Qualey
oneLineBio: Energy and environmental law attorney at Bernstein Shur.
bio: Richard is an energy and environmental attorney at Bernstein Shur who pairs a chemical engineering background with legal counsel on land use, environmental compliance, and regulatory matters. He previously clerked for the Maine Supreme Judicial Court.

name: Kerem Durdag
oneLineBio: President & COO of Great Works Internet (GWI).
bio: Kerem Durdag is President and COO of GWI, Maine's B Corp-certified internet provider, where he has led rural broadband buildouts across the state. He also helped launch the Indus Fund, providing below-market loans to Maine's immigrant business community.

name: Sam Merkatz
oneLineBio: Studying government and science, technology & society at Colby College.
bio: Sam Merkatz is a recent Colby College graduate who studied government and science, technology, and society, with a focus on tech policy and regulation. He previously interned as a Virtual Student Federal Service fellow at the U.S. Department of State and won Colby's 2025 Government Department Prize.
